items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: So he recommended me to Lionel Hampton, and I joined his band after he left Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: No, T-bone wasn't in that band, in fact I didn't even know T-bone had played with Lionel Hampton. No, I was with Lionel's first band when -- after he left Benny Goodman.
Right. It was later on that --
